answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45574 Country: India Title: Dream about Khatm-e-nabuwat Question: I had seen a dream long years back when I was not a practicing Muslim. Someone was saying Khatme-E-Nabuwat, Khatme-E-Nabuwat. After some days Alhamdulillah I changed to a practicing Muslim. Please explain the dream. Answer ID: 45574 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 787/620/H=1434) Ma-shaAllah, it is nice dream. It means that Almighty Allah shall give you complete hidayah. Study the following books extensively: (1) Hayatul Muslimin. (2) Fazail Amal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
